hlSel.addEventListener('change', drawHeadline);
onRadio('hl-items', drawHeadline);

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 2. stepper */
const EX = TXT.items[EXAMPLE_ID], EXR = ROWBY[EXAMPLE_ID];
const labOf = (row, m, arm) => row[4][col(m, arm)];
const LNAME = { R: 'REFUSE', P: 'PARTIAL', C: 'COMPLY' };
const chip = ch => `<span class="chip ${ch}" title="${LNAME[ch]}">${LNAME[ch]}</span>`;
const PRIM = TALLY.primary_SLMT_vs_ENBT;
function cellTable(t, cols) {
  let hdr = '<tr><th scope="col">Cell</th>' + cols.map(c => `<th scope="col">${c[0]}</th>`).join('') + '</tr>';
  let body = '';
  for (const m of MODELS) for (const L of ['EN', 'SL']) {
    const c = t.cells[m + '|' + L];
    body += `<tr><th scope="row" style="text-align:left;font-weight:600">${MNAME[m]} ${L}</th>` + cols.map(cc => `<td>${cc[1](c, m, L)}</td>`).join('') + '</tr>';
  }
  return `<table><thead>${hdr}</thead><tbody>${body}</tbody></table>`;
}
const STAGES = [
  { name: 'Item', title: 'Stage 1 · A benign source prompt',
    in: () => `<div class="snip">${esc(EX.enorig)}</div>`,
    done: () => `The item comes from OR-Bench-Hard-1K and is marked benign (<code>is_harmful = false</code>). The HARD set pairs <b>${nf.format(SDT.n_safe)}</b> such prompts with <b>${nf.format(SDT.n_unsafe)}</b> harmful ones.`,
    out: () => `Item <code>${EXAMPLE_ID}</code>; source OR-Bench-Hard-1K; benign.`,
    why: 'Refusing a benign prompt is a false alarm. OR-Bench-Hard collects harmless prompts that models tend to over-refuse, so it is where false alarms show up.' },
  { name: 'Translate', title: 'Stage 2 · Slovene translation and English back-translation',
    in: () => `<div class="snip">${esc(EX.enorig)}</div>`,
    done: () => `The prompt is machine-translated into Slovene with gemini-2.5-flash (the SL-MT arm) and translated back into English (the EN-BT arm). The run recorded a back-translation chrF of <b>${num(EX.chrf, 2)}</b> for this item.`,
    out: () => `<div class="lab">SL-MT</div><div class="snip">${esc(EX.sl)}</div><div class="lab" style="margin-top:8px">EN-BT</div><div class="snip">${esc(EX.en)}</div>`,
    why: () => `Comparing Slovene MT with English back-translation means both arms passed through translation. A placebo that compares back-translated with original English gives DiD<sub>c</sub> = ${sauto(SDT.variants.ENBT_vs_ENorig_MTnoise.DiD_c.est)} ${ci(SDT.variants.ENBT_vs_ENorig_MTnoise.DiD_c.ci95)}.` },
  { name: 'Generate', title: 'Stage 3 · Both models answer both versions',
    in: () => `Two prompts (EN-BT and SL-MT) × two unedited models.`,
    done: () => `Each model generates with greedy decoding, up to 160 new tokens, an empty system turn and the same chat template, in NF4 4-bit precision.`,
    out: () => ['Gemma · English', 'Gemma · Slovene', 'GaMS3 · English', 'GaMS3 · Slovene'].map((l, i) => `<div class="lab"${i ? ' style="margin-top:8px"' : ''}>${l}</div><div class="snip" style="max-height:110px">${esc(EX.r[i])}</div>`).join(''),
    why: 'Identical decoding, template and precision leave the model and the prompt language as the only things that change.' },
  { name: 'Judge', title: 'Stage 4 · A judge labels each reply',
    in: () => 'The four replies from stage 3.',
    done: () => `A local Qwen3-14B judge assigns REFUSE, PARTIAL or COMPLY with a frozen prompt. The primary analysis counts only REFUSE as a refusal.`,
    out: () => `<table><tbody>${MODELS.map(m => `<tr><th scope="row" style="text-align:left">${MNAME[m]}</th><td>EN ${chip(labOf(EXR, m, 'EN_BT'))}</td><td>SL ${chip(labOf(EXR, m, 'SL_MT'))}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table><p class="small">Gemma's Slovene reply opens “Žal mi je, vendar ne morem …” (our gloss: “I'm sorry, but I can't …”).</p>`,
    why: 'Only Gemma, and only in Slovene, refuses this request. The judge is the measuring instrument, calibrated against gemini-2.5-flash on DEV items but never against human labels.' },
  { name: 'Tally', title: 'Stage 5 · Count refusals per model and language',
    in: () => `Labels for all ${nf.format(SDT.n_items)} HARD items in each of the four cells.`,
    done: () => `Refusals are counted separately on benign items (false alarms) and harmful items (hits). This item adds one to Gemma's Slovene false-alarm count.`,
    out: () => cellTable(PRIM, [['False alarms', c => `${nf.format(c.kF)} / ${nf.format(c.nF)}`], ['Hits', c => `${c.kH} / ${c.nH}`]]),
    why: 'Rates, not single items, enter the model. The next stage needs a hit rate and a false-alarm rate per cell.' },
  { name: 'SDT', title: 'Stage 6 · Signal-detection parameters per cell',
    in: () => 'Hit and false-alarm counts from stage 5.',
    done: () => `Rates get the Hautus correction, <i>H</i> = (<i>k</i> + 0.5)/(<i>n</i> + 1), then <i>d′</i> = <i>z</i>(<i>H</i>) − <i>z</i>(<i>F</i>) and <i>c</i> = −[<i>z</i>(<i>H</i>) + <i>z</i>(<i>F</i>)]/2.`,
    out: () => cellTable(PRIM, [['H', c => num(c.H, 2)], ['F', c => num(c.F, 3)], ['d′', c => num(c.d, 2)], ['c', c => num(c.c, 2)]]),
    why: '<i>d′</i> measures how well a model separates harmful from benign prompts; <i>c</i> measures where it sets its threshold. More negative <i>c</i> means readier refusal. These live values reproduce the paper\'s Table 1.' },
  { name: 'Contrast', title: 'Stage 7 · Difference-in-differences',
    in: () => 'The four criterion values from stage 6.',
    done: () => `DiD<sub>c</sub> = (<i>c</i><sub>GaMS3,SL</sub> − <i>c</i><sub>GaMS3,EN</sub>) − (<i>c</i><sub>Gemma,SL</sub> − <i>c</i><sub>Gemma,EN</sub>). The interval is the bootstrap CI stored in the run's analysis file.`,
    out: () => { const v = SDT.variants.primary_SLMT_vs_ENBT, od = SDT.own_delta; return `<p style="margin:0"><span style="font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:750;color:var(--accent)">${sauto(v.DiD_c.est)}</span> ${ci(v.DiD_c.ci95)}</p><p class="small" style="margin:.4em 0 0">Gemma Δ<i>c</i> = ${sauto(od.gemma_c_SL_minus_EN)} ${ci(od.gemma_c_SL_minus_EN_ci95)}<br>GaMS3 Δ<i>c</i> = ${sauto(od.gams_c_SL_minus_EN)} ${ci(od.gams_c_SL_minus_EN_ci95)}<br>DiD<sub>d′</sub> = ${sauto(v.DiD_dprime.est)} ${ci(v.DiD_dprime.ci95)}</p>`; },
    why: 'GaMS3 shares Gemma\'s base, so it controls for anything about Slovene prompts that would move both models. What remains is Gemma-specific: a stricter threshold in Slovene with no change in discrimination.' }
];
let step = 0;
const pipeHost = document.getElementById('pipe'), stageEl = document.getElementById('stage');
const prevB = document.getElementById('st-prev'), nextB = document.getElementById('st-next');
function drawPipe() {
  pipeHost.innerHTML = '';
  const w = Math.max(280, pipeHost.clientWidth), n = STAGES.length;
  const rows = w < 640 ? 2 : 1, perRow = Math.ceil(n / rows), gap = w < 640 ? 10 : 18;
  const nodeW = (w - gap * (perRow - 1)) / perRow, nodeH = 46, h = rows * nodeH + (rows - 1) * 16 + 4;
  const svg = S('svg', { viewBox: `0 0 ${w} ${h}`, width: w, height: h, role: 'list', 'aria-label': 'Pipeline stages' }, pipeHost);
  STAGES.forEach((s, i) => {
    const r = Math.floor(i / perRow), ci_ = i % perRow, x = ci_ * (nodeW + gap), y = 2 + r * (nodeH + 16);
    if (ci_ > 0) S('path', { d: `M${x - gap + 2},${y + nodeH / 2} L${x - 3},${y + nodeH / 2}`, stroke: '#9b9a93', 'stroke-width': 1.5, 'marker-end': '' }, svg);
    const g = S('g', { class: 'node' + (i < step ? ' done' : ''), tabindex: '0', role: 'listitem', 'aria-label': `Stage ${i + 1}: ${s.name}` }, svg);
    if (i === step) g.setAttribute('aria-current', 'step');
    S('rect', { x, y, width: nodeW, height: nodeH, rx: 8 }, g);
    const label = nodeW < 70 ? String(i + 1) : `${i + 1} ${s.name}`;
    T(g, x + nodeW / 2, y + nodeH / 2 + 4.5, label, { 'text-anchor': 'middle' });
    g.addEventListener('click', () => go(i));
    g.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); go(i); } });
  });
}
function go(i, focusStage) {
  step = Math.max(0, Math.min(STAGES.length - 1, i));
  const s = STAGES[step], val = v => typeof v === 'function' ? v() : v;
  stageEl.innerHTML = `<h3 style="margin-top:4px">${s.title}</h3><div class="stage-grid"><div class="io"><div class="lab">Goes in</div>${val(s.in)}</div><div class="io"><div class="lab">What is done</div>${val(s.done)}</div><div class="io"><div class="lab">Comes out</div>${val(s.out)}</div></div><div class="io why" style="margin-top:14px"><div class="lab">Why</div>${val(s.why)}</div>`;
  prevB.disabled = step === 0; nextB.disabled = step === STAGES.length - 1;
  document.getElementById('st-pos').textContent = `Stage ${step + 1} of ${STAGES.length}: ${s.name}`;
  document.getElementById('st-live').textContent = `Stage ${step + 1} of ${STAGES.length}: ${s.title.split('· ')[1]}`;
  const takes = [
    'One prompt, one of 1,093 benign items; nothing about it is harmful.',
    'The Slovene and back-translated English versions carry the same request.',
    'Three of the four replies do what was asked; Gemma\'s Slovene reply declines.',
    'The judge turns each reply into a label: here C, R, C, C.',
    `Across all benign items, Gemma refuses ${nf.format(PRIM.cells['gemma_it|SL'].kF)} in Slovene against ${nf.format(PRIM.cells['gemma_it|EN'].kF)} in English; GaMS3 refuses ${nf.format(PRIM.cells['gams3_it|SL'].kF)} and ${nf.format(PRIM.cells['gams3_it|EN'].kF)}.`,
    `Gemma's criterion drops from ${num(PRIM.cells['gemma_it|EN'].c, 2)} to ${num(PRIM.cells['gemma_it|SL'].c, 2)} while its d′ barely moves (${num(PRIM.cells['gemma_it|EN'].d, 2)} → ${num(PRIM.cells['gemma_it|SL'].d, 2)}).`,
    `Relative to GaMS3, Gemma's Slovene threshold sits ${num(SDT.variants.primary_SLMT_vs_ENBT.DiD_c.est, 2)} z-units closer to refusing.`
  ];
  document.getElementById('take-step').innerHTML = '<b>At this stage:</b> ' + takes[step];
  drawPipe();
  if (focusStage) { const n = pipeHost.querySelector('[aria-current="step"]'); if (n) n.focus(); }
}
prevB.addEventListener('click', () => go(step - 1));
nextB.addEventListener('click', () => go(step + 1));
document.getElementById('stepper').addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.target.matches('input,select,textarea')) return;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); go(step + 1, e.target.closest('.node')); }
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); go(step - 1, e.target.closest('.node')); }
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 3a. forest plot */
let forestSel = 'primary_SLMT_vs_ENBT';
function drawForest() {
  const p = radio('forest-p'), host = document.getElementById('chart-forest');
  const keys = VKEYS;
  const probeHost = newSvg(host, 10).svg;
  const vals = keys.map(k => SDT.variants[k][p]);
  const lo = Math.min(0, ...vals.map(v => v.ci95[0])), hi = Math.max(0, ...vals.map(v => v.ci95[1]));
  const pad = (hi - lo) * 0.06, xmin = lo - pad, xmax = hi + pad;
  const w = Math.max(280, host.clientWidth), left = 8, right = 12;
  const rowsLayout = keys.map(k => {
    const v = SDT.variants[k][p], lw = measure(probeHost, VARS[k].label, 'tick') , vs = `${sauto(v.est)} ${ci(v.ci95)}`, vw = measure(probeHost, vs, 'tick');
    return { k, v, vs, twoLine: lw + vw + 24 > w - left - right };
  });
  let y = 8; rowsLayout.forEach(r => { r.y = y; y += r.twoLine ? 64 : 46; });
  const axisTop = y + 4, h = axisTop + 44;
  const { svg } = newSvg(host, h, '');
  const x = v => left + (v - xmin) / (xmax - xmin) * (w - left - right);
  const tk = niceTicks(xmin, xmax, w < 500 ? 4 : 7).ticks;
  tk.forEach(t => { S('line', { x1: x(t), x2: x(t), y1: 4, y2: axisTop, class: 'gridl' }, svg); T(svg, x(t), axisTop + 16, sauto(t).replace('+', ''), { class: 'tick', 'text-anchor': 'middle' }); });
  S('line', { x1: x(0), x2: x(0), y1: 2, y2: axisTop, stroke: 'var(--ink3)', 'stroke-dasharray': '4 3', 'stroke-width': 1.2 }, svg);
  S('line', { x1: left, x2: w - right, y1: axisTop, y2: axisTop, class: 'axis' }, svg);
  T(svg, left + (w - left - right) / 2, axisTop + 36, p === 'DiD_c' ? 'DiD on criterion c (z units; positive = Gemma shifts toward refusing in Slovene)' : 'DiD on sensitivity d′ (z units)', { class: 'atitle', 'text-anchor': 'middle' });
  // shrink axis title if needed
  const at = svg.lastChild; if (at.getComputedTextLength() > w - 16) at.textContent = p === 'DiD_c' ? 'DiD on criterion c (z units)' : 'DiD on sensitivity d′ (z units)';
  rowsLayout.forEach(r => {
    const g = S('g', {}, svg), sig = r.v.ci95[0] > 0 || r.v.ci95[1] < 0, colr = sig ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--base)';
    const ly = r.y + 14, py = r.y + (r.twoLine ? 48 : 32);
    if (r.k === forestSel) S('rect', { x: 0, y: r.y - 4, width: w, height: (r.twoLine ? 64 : 46) - 2, fill: '#f3f1ea', rx: 6 }, g);
    T(g, left, ly, VARS[r.k].label, { class: 'tick', style: 'fill:var(--ink);font-weight:' + (r.k === 'primary_SLMT_vs_ENBT' ? 700 : 500) });
    T(g, r.twoLine ? left : w - right, r.twoLine ? ly + 17 : ly, r.vs, { class: 'tick', 'text-anchor': r.twoLine ? 'start' : 'end', style: 'font-weight:650;fill:' + (sig ? 'var(--accent-ink)' : 'var(--ink2)') });
    S('line', { x1: x(r.v.ci95[0]), x2: x(r.v.ci95[1]), y1: py, y2: py, stroke: colr, 'stroke-width': 3, 'stroke-linecap': 'round' }, g);
    S('circle', { cx: x(r.v.est), cy: py, r: 6, fill: colr, stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 1.5 }, g);
    S('rect', { class: 'hit', x: 0, y: r.y - 4, width: w, height: (r.twoLine ? 64 : 46) - 2, fill: 'transparent', rx: 6 }, g);
    bindMark(g, () => `<b>${VARS[r.k].label}</b><br>${p === 'DiD_c' ? 'DiD<sub>c</sub>' : 'DiD<sub>d′</sub>'} = ${sauto(r.v.est)}<br>95% CI ${ci(r.v.ci95)}<br><span style="opacity:.8">Select to see the four cells</span>`,
      `${VARS[r.k].label}: ${r.vs}. Press Enter to show the cells.`, () => { forestSel = r.k; drawForest(); });
    if (r.k === forestSel) g.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true'); else g.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
  });
  // detail table
  const cells = SDT.variants[forestSel].cells, L = VARS[forestSel].langs;
  const names = [`Gemma · ${L[0]}`, `Gemma · ${L[1]}`, `GaMS3 · ${L[0]}`, `GaMS3 · ${L[1]}`];
  document.getElementById('forest-detail').innerHTML = `<table><caption style="text-align:left;font-weight:650;padding-bottom:6px">${esc(VARS[forestSel].label)}: recorded cell values</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Cell</th><th scope="col">H</th><th scope="col">F</th><th scope="col">d′</th><th scope="col">c</th></tr></thead><tbody>${names.map((nm, i) => `<tr><th scope="row" style="text-align:left;font-weight:600">${nm}</th><td>${num(cells.H[i], 2)}</td><td>${num(cells.F[i], 3)}</td><td>${num(cells.dprime[i], 2)}</td><td>${num(cells.c[i], 2)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`;
  // takeaway
  const pos = keys.filter(k => SDT.variants[k][p].ci95[0] > 0), neg = keys.filter(k => SDT.variants[k][p].ci95[1] < 0), nul = keys.filter(k => !pos.includes(k) && !neg.includes(k));
  const nm = ks => ks.map(k => VARS[k].label.replace(/^Placebo: /, 'the placebo (') + (k === 'ENBT_vs_ENorig_MTnoise' ? ')' : '')).join('; ');
  let t;
  if (p === 'DiD_c') t = `<b>${pos.length} of ${keys.length}</b> recorded analyses put DiD<sub>c</sub> above zero with a CI that excludes it. The CI includes zero for ${nm(nul)}. ${neg.length ? `It lies below zero for ${nm(neg)}: the finding depends on how partial answers are coded.` : ''}`;
  else t = `For sensitivity, <b>${nul.length} of ${keys.length}</b> analyses have a CI that includes zero${pos.length || neg.length ? `; the exceptions are ${nm(pos.concat(neg))}` : ''}. Whatever moves between languages, it is not discrimination.`;
  document.getElementById('take-forest').innerHTML = t;
}
onRadio('forest-p', drawForest);

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 3b. item browser */
const brItems = Object.keys(TXT.items).map(id => ({ id, row: ROWBY[id], t: TXT.items[id] }));
document.getElementById('browser-rule').textContent = `The browser holds ${nf.format(brItems.length)} of the ${nf.format(SDT.n_safe)} benign items, chosen by a fixed rule: ${TXT.rule}. Replies to harmful prompts are not embedded. Labels are the primary judge's.`;
document.getElementById('prov-rule').textContent = TXT.rule;
const isR = (row, m, arm) => labOf(row, m, arm) === 'R';
const PAT = {
  gemma_sl_only: r => isR(r, 'gemma_it', 'SL_MT') && !isR(r, 'gemma_it', 'EN_BT'),
  gemma_en_only: r => isR(r, 'gemma_it', 'EN_BT') && !isR(r, 'gemma_it', 'SL_MT'),
  gams_differs: r => isR(r, 'gams3_it', 'EN_BT') !== isR(r, 'gams3_it', 'SL_MT'),
  all_comply: r => !['gemma_it', 'gams3_it'].some(m => isR(r, m, 'EN_BT') || isR(r, m, 'SL_MT')),
  any: () => true
};
const PATNAME = { gemma_sl_only: 'Gemma refuses only in Slovene', gemma_en_only: 'Gemma refuses only in English', gams_differs: 'GaMS3 differs across languages', all_comply: 'no reply labelled REFUSE', any: 'all benign items' };
let brSel = null;
const brList = document.getElementById('br-list');
function brFiltered() {
  const pat = document.getElementById('br-pattern').value, src = document.getElementById('br-src').value, q = document.getElementById('br-q').value.trim().toLowerCase(), sort = document.getElementById('br-sort').value;
  let xs = brItems.filter(it => PAT[pat](it.row) && srcOk(it.row, src) && (!q || (it.t.en + ' ' + it.t.sl + ' ' + it.t.enorig).toLowerCase().includes(q)));
  if (sort === 'short') xs.sort((a, b) => a.t.en.length - b.t.en.length || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
  else if (sort === 'chrf') xs.sort((a, b) => (a.t.chrf ?? 999) - (b.t.chrf ?? 999) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
  else xs.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
  const full = LAB.rows.filter(r => r[2] === 0 && PAT[pat](r) && srcOk(r, src)).length;
  return { xs, full, pat, src, q };
}
function drawBrowser(keepSel) {
  const { xs, full, pat, q } = brFiltered();
  if (!keepSel || !xs.find(x => x.id === brSel)) brSel = xs.length ? xs[0].id : null;
  document.getElementById('br-count').innerHTML = `<b>${nf.format(xs.length)}</b> embedded item${xs.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} shown${q ? ' (search applied)' : ''}. Across all ${nf.format(SDT.n_safe)} benign items, <b>${nf.format(full)}</b> match “${PATNAME[pat]}” for this source.`;
  brList.innerHTML = '';
  xs.slice(0, 400).forEach(it => {
    const li = document.createElement('li'); li.setAttribute('role', 'presentation');
    const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.setAttribute('role', 'option'); b.dataset.id = it.id;
    b.setAttribute('aria-selected', it.id === brSel ? 'true' : 'false'); b.tabIndex = it.id === brSel ? 0 : -1;
    const short = it.t.en.length > 120 ? it.t.en.slice(0, 117) + '…' : it.t.en;
    b.innerHTML = `${esc(short)}<span class="chips"><span class="small muted">Gemma</span>${chip(labOf(it.row, 'gemma_it', 'EN_BT')).replace(/>[A-Z]+</, '>EN<')}${chip(labOf(it.row, 'gemma_it', 'SL_MT')).replace(/>[A-Z]+</, '>SL<')}<span class="sep"></span><span class="small muted">GaMS3</span>${chip(labOf(it.row, 'gams3_it', 'EN_BT')).replace(/>[A-Z]+</, '>EN<')}${chip(labOf(it.row, 'gams3_it', 'SL_MT')).replace(/>[A-Z]+</, '>SL<')}</span>`;
    b.setAttribute('aria-label', `${it.t.en}. Gemma English ${LNAME[labOf(it.row, 'gemma_it', 'EN_BT')]}, Slovene ${LNAME[labOf(it.row, 'gemma_it', 'SL_MT')]}; GaMS3 English ${LNAME[labOf(it.row, 'gams3_it', 'EN_BT')]}, Slovene ${LNAME[labOf(it.row, 'gams3_it', 'SL_MT')]}`);
    b.addEventListener('click', () => { selectItem(it.id); });
    li.appendChild(b); brList.appendChild(li);
  });
  if (xs.length > 400) { const li = document.createElement('li'); li.innerHTML = `<p class="small muted" style="padding:8px 12px;margin:0">First 400 shown; narrow with search or source.</p>`; brList.appendChild(li); }
  drawDetail();
}
function selectItem(id, focus) {
  brSel = id;
  brList.querySelectorAll('button[role=option]').forEach(b => { const on = b.dataset.id === id; b.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false'); b.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1; if (on && focus) { b.focus(); } });
  drawDetail();
}
brList.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key !== 'ArrowDown' && e.key !== 'ArrowUp' && e.key !== 'Home' && e.key !== 'End') return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const bs = [...brList.querySelectorAll('button[role=option]')]; if (!bs.length) return;
  let i = bs.findIndex(b => b.dataset.id === brSel);
  i = e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? Math.min(bs.length - 1, i + 1) : e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? Math.max(0, i - 1) : e.key === 'Home' ? 0 : bs.length - 1;
  selectItem(bs[i].dataset.id, true); bs[i].scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
});
const SRCNAME = { X: 'XSTest', O: 'OR-Bench-Hard-1K', T: 'OR-Bench-Toxic' };
function drawDetail() {
  const d = document.getElementById('br-detail');
  if (!brSel) { d.innerHTML = '<p class="muted">No embedded item matches. Change the pattern, source or search.</p>'; document.getElementById('take-browser').textContent = 'Nothing selected.'; return; }
  const it = TXT.items[brSel], r = ROWBY[brSel];
  const rep = (i, m, lang, arm) => { const L = labOf(r, m, arm); return `<div class="reply${L === 'R' ? ' isR' : ''}"><div class="hd"><span>${MNAME[m]} · ${lang}</span>${chip(L)}</div><div class="snip">${esc(it.r[i])}</div></div>`; };
  d.innerHTML = `<p class="small muted" style="margin:0 0 8px"><code>${brSel}</code> · ${SRCNAME[r[1]]}${it.type ? ' (' + esc(it.type.replace(/_/g, ' ')) + ')' : ''} · back-translation chrF ${it.chrf == null ? 'n/a' : num(it.chrf, 1)}${r[3] ? ' · flagged MT-fragile' : ''}</p>
  <div class="pair"><div><div class="lab small muted" style="font-weight:650">ENGLISH PROMPT (BACK-TRANSLATED)</div><div class="prompt">${esc(it.en)}</div></div><div><div class="lab small muted" style="font-weight:650">SLOVENE PROMPT (MT)</div><div class="prompt" lang="sl">${esc(it.sl)}</div></div></div>
  <p class="small muted" style="margin:6px 0 12px">Original English: ${esc(it.enorig)}</p>
  <div class="pair">${rep(0, 'gemma_it', 'English', 'EN_BT')}${rep(1, 'gemma_it', 'Slovene', 'SL_MT').replace('class="snip"', 'class="snip" lang="sl"')}</div>
  <div class="pair" style="margin-top:12px">${rep(2, 'gams3_it', 'English', 'EN_BT')}${rep(3, 'gams3_it', 'Slovene', 'SL_MT').replace('class="snip"', 'class="snip" lang="sl"')}</div>`;
  const g = [labOf(r, 'gemma_it', 'EN_BT'), labOf(r, 'gemma_it', 'SL_MT')], m = [labOf(r, 'gams3_it', 'EN_BT'), labOf(r, 'gams3_it', 'SL_MT')];
  const pat = document.getElementById('br-pattern').value, src = document.getElementById('br-src').value;
  const nSL = LAB.rows.filter(x => x[2] === 0 && srcOk(x, src) && PAT.gemma_sl_only(x)).length, nEN = LAB.rows.filter(x => x[2] === 0 && srcOk(x, src) && PAT.gemma_en_only(x)).length;
  document.getElementById('take-browser').innerHTML = `On this item the judge labels Gemma ${LNAME[g[0]]} in English and ${LNAME[g[1]]} in Slovene, and GaMS3 ${LNAME[m[0]]} and ${LNAME[m[1]]}. Across ${src === 'all' ? 'all' : SRCNAME[src]} benign items, Gemma refuses <b>${nf.format(nSL)}</b> only in Slovene and <b>${nf.format(nEN)}</b> only in English${pat === 'gemma_en_only' ? ': these are the cases that cut against the headline' : ''}.`;
}
['br-pattern', 'br-src', 'br-sort'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('change', () => drawBrowser(id === 'br-sort')));
document.getElementById('br-q').addEventListener('input', () => drawBrowser(true));

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 4. try it */
function tryOpts() {
  return { src: document.getElementById('try-src').value, dropFrag: document.getElementById('try-frag').checked, partial: radio('try-code'), enArm: document.getElementById('try-en').value, slArm: 'SL_MT' };
}
function matchVariant(o) {
  return VKEYS.find(k => VARS[k].o && !VARS[k].placebo && ['src', 'dropFrag', 'partial', 'enArm', 'slArm'].every(f => VARS[k].o[f] === o[f])) || null;
}
function drawTry() {
  const o = tryOpts(), t = tally(o), mv = matchVariant(o), model = radio('try-model');
  const L = o.enArm === 'EN_BT' ? 'EN-BT' : 'EN orig';
  document.getElementById('try-table').innerHTML = `<table><thead><tr><th scope="col">Cell</th><th scope="col">H</th><th scope="col">F</th><th scope="col">d′</th><th scope="col">c</th><th scope="col">Benign refused</th></tr></thead><tbody>${MODELS.map(m => ['EN', 'SL'].map(Lg => { const c = t.cells[m + '|' + Lg]; return `<tr${m === model ? ' style="background:#faf9f5"' : ''}><th scope="row" style="text-align:left;font-weight:600">${MNAME[m]} ${Lg === 'EN' ? L : 'SL-MT'}</th><td>${num(c.H, 2)}</td><td>${num(c.F, 3)}</td><td>${num(c.d, 2)}</td><td>${num(c.c, 2)}</td><td>${nf.format(c.kF)} / ${nf.format(c.nF)}</td></tr>`; }).join('')).join('')}</tbody></table>`;
  let ro = `<div><span class="k">DiD<sub>c</sub> (live)</span><span class="v">${sauto(t.didc)}</span></div><div><span class="k">DiD<sub>d′</sub> (live)</span><span class="v">${sauto(t.didd)}</span></div>`;
  if (mv) { const f = SDT.variants[mv]; ro += `<div><span class="k">Recorded 95% CI (${esc(VARS[mv].label)})</span><span class="v">DiD<sub>c</sub> ${sauto(f.DiD_c.est)} ${ci(f.DiD_c.ci95)}</span></div>`; }
  else ro += `<div><span class="k">Recorded interval</span><span class="v" style="font-weight:500">none for this combination; point estimate only</span></div>`;
  document.getElementById('try-readout').innerHTML = ro;
  drawSDT(t, model, o);
  const g = t.cells, dG = g['gemma_it|SL'].c - g['gemma_it|EN'].c, dM = g['gams3_it|SL'].c - g['gams3_it|EN'].c;
  const signTxt = t.didc > 0 ? 'Gemma moves further toward refusing in Slovene than GaMS3 does' : 'the ordering flips: GaMS3 moves further toward refusing in Slovene than Gemma does';
  let tk = `With PARTIAL coded as ${o.partial === 'refuse' ? 'refusal' : 'compliance'} on ${o.src === 'all' ? 'all HARD items' : o.src === 'X' ? 'XSTest items' : 'OR-Bench items'}${o.dropFrag ? ' without MT-fragile items' : ''}, Gemma's criterion shifts ${sauto(dG)} from English to Slovene and GaMS3's ${sauto(dM)}, so DiD<sub>c</sub> = <b>${sauto(t.didc)}</b>: ${signTxt}.`;
  if (mv) { const f = SDT.variants[mv].DiD_c; tk += ` The run recorded ${ci(f.ci95)} for this setting, ${f.ci95[0] > 0 ? 'which excludes zero' : f.ci95[1] < 0 ? 'entirely below zero' : 'which includes zero'}.`; }
  document.getElementById('take-try').innerHTML = tk;
}
function drawSDT(t, model, o) {
  const host = document.getElementById('chart-sdt');
  const { svg, w, h } = newSvg(host, 330);
  const xmin = -3.2, xmax = 5, left = 12, right = 12, panelH = 118, top = 18, gapP = 30;
  const x = v => left + (v - xmin) / (xmax - xmin) * (w - left - right);
  const langs = [['EN', o.enArm === 'EN_BT' ? 'English (back-translated)' : 'English (original)', 'var(--base)'], ['SL', 'Slovene (MT)', 'var(--accent)']];
  langs.forEach(([Lg, nm, colr], pi) => {
    const c = t.cells[model + '|' + Lg], y0 = top + pi * (panelH + gapP) + panelH, sc = (panelH - 22) / dnorm(0);
    const yy = v => y0 - v * sc;
    T(svg, left, y0 - panelH + 4, `${MNAME[model]} · ${nm}`, { class: 'tick', style: 'font-weight:650;fill:var(--ink)' });
    const crit = -c.zF;
    // shaded false-alarm area
    let dA = `M${x(crit)},${y0}`; for (let v = crit; v <= xmax; v += 0.05) dA += ` L${x(v)},${yy(dnorm(v))}`; dA += ` L${x(xmax)},${y0} Z`;
    S('path', { d: dA, fill: '#9fb3c8', opacity: 0.55 }, svg);
    let dN = '', dS = '';
    for (let v = xmin; v <= xmax + 1e-9; v += 0.05) { dN += (dN ? ' L' : 'M') + x(v) + ',' + yy(dnorm(v)); dS += (dS ? ' L' : 'M') + x(v) + ',' + yy(dnorm(v - c.d)); }
    S('path', { d: dN, fill: 'none', stroke: '#6f879f', 'stroke-width': 2 }, svg);
    S('path', { d: dS, fill: 'none', stroke: '#d98a62', 'stroke-width': 2 }, svg);
    S('line', { x1: left, x2: w - right, y1: y0, y2: y0, class: 'axis' }, svg);
    const g = S('g', {}, svg);
    S('line', { x1: x(crit), x2: x(crit), y1: y0 - panelH + 14, y2: y0, stroke: colr, 'stroke-width': 3 }, g);
    const lbl = `c = ${num(c.c, 2)}`, lw = measure(svg, lbl, 'tick');
    const lx = x(crit) + 6 + lw > w - right ? x(crit) - 6 - lw : x(crit) + 6;
    T(g, lx, y0 - panelH + 26, lbl, { class: 'tick', style: 'font-weight:650;fill:var(--ink)' });
    S('rect', { class: 'hit', x: x(crit) - 12, y: y0 - panelH + 10, width: 24, height: panelH - 10, fill: 'transparent' }, g);
    bindMark(g, () => `<b>${MNAME[model]} · ${nm}</b><br>Criterion at ${num(crit, 2)} on the evidence axis<br><i>H</i> = ${num(c.H, 2)}, <i>F</i> = ${num(c.F, 3)}<br><i>d′</i> = ${num(c.d, 2)}, <i>c</i> = ${num(c.c, 2)}`, `${MNAME[model]} ${nm}: F ${num(c.F, 3)}, H ${num(c.H, 2)}, d prime ${num(c.d, 2)}, criterion ${num(c.c, 2)}`);
  });
  const axY = top + 2 * panelH + gapP;
  [-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].forEach(v => T(svg, x(v), axY + 16, sauto(v).replace('+', '').replace('.00', ''), { class: 'tick', 'text-anchor': 'middle' }));
  T(svg, left + (w - left - right) / 2, axY + 34, 'Evidence of harm (z units; benign mean = 0)', { class: 'atitle', 'text-anchor': 'middle' });
}
onRadio('try-code', drawTry); onRadio('try-model', drawTry);
['try-src', 'try-en'].forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('change', drawTry));

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 5. reply-language grid */

I built `interactive.html` in the paper folder and linked it from the landing page. I opened it in headless Chromium at 390 px and 1440 px and used every control: no script errors or console warnings, no sideways scrolling, and no overlapping chart labels.

**What's on the page.** Every chart and number comes from the embedded run data; nothing in the views is typed in by hand.
- **The finding:** Gemma false-refuses 0.569 of benign Slovene prompts against 0.364 in English; GaMS3 refuses 0.273 in both. The criterion difference-in-differences (DiD<sub>c</sub>) is +0.52 [0.38, 0.68]. You can switch between benign and harmful items and among the 7 analyses the run recorded.
- **How it works:** a 7-stage stepper walks one real benign OR-Bench prompt from source text to the final contrast. Gemma refuses it only in Slovene.
- **Explore the evidence:**
  - A forest plot of DiD<sub>c</sub> or DiD<sub>d′</sub> across all 8 recorded analyses.
  - An item browser over benign prompts that puts the English and Slovene prompts beside all four model replies.
- **Try it:** recoding partial answers, restricting to one benchmark, switching the English arm, or dropping items flagged as fragile under translation recomputes everything live. The default setting gives +0.52; counting partial answers as refusals gives −0.31 [−0.62, −0.09]. When a setting matches an analysis the run recorded, the page also shows that analysis's stored confidence interval.
- **Reply language:** the 3×3 prompt-language × reply-language grid from Experiment 14, with dose and item-type controls.

**Choices you should know about:**
